name: @noralos-plugins/noralai-google-sheets
description: NoralAI Google Sheets integration. Wraps the Google Sheets v4 REST API and a Drive v3 spreadsheet-discovery helper behind a NoralOS-branded plugin surface using OAuth 2.0 (refresh-token) credentials from the company's integration_credentials row. Exposes agent tools for listing spreadsheets, reading ranges, appending rows, and updating ranges so NoralOS agents can read context from and append activity to operator-owned spreadsheets.
